comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Tiny rural Alaska hydro electric utility combined with telephone and broadband; telecom mix and remote-community profile differ from ConEd's urban networks.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; similar regulatory model but different product than electricity, gas and steam delivery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Regulated integrated electric and natural gas utility selling to residential, commercial and industrial customers; owns T&D networks like ConEd.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Upstream gas producer with power generation and carbon capture; unregulated commodity producer, not a regulated delivery utility.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regulated natural gas and electric distribution utility with pipelines; mostly regulated delivery, though propane adds some unregulated mix.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Arizona water and wastewater utility serving master-planned communities; different commodity and growth-driven developer connections.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution utility serving residential and commercial customers with clean energy investments, similar to ConEd's gas and clean energy lines.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Regulated natural gas distribution utility billing residential and commercial customers through owned pipelines, matching ConEd's gas business, though smaller and gas-only.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Unregulated retail propane and fuel oil distributor using trucks and HVAC services; not a regulated network utility.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Regulated electric utility holding company owning transmission and distribution networks serving residential, commercial and industrial customers, like ConEd's electric business.
